(4) The detail-header xprompts_used response field, pinned in tests/perf/bench_detail_header_summary.py. (5) Stats response keys, still read through mirror constants (request keys already send macro_*). The matching terminology-guard rows point at sase-1eq.10 in tests/_macro_terminology_strings.py and the pair tables; drop them when the wire flips.
